## Results

- Assets reduced 72.3 MB to 6.3 MB via WebP
- All 19 campaign missions pass validation
- PWA precache 77 MB to 8.98 MB

## The problem

Taking a feature-complete app through store compliance, asset size and multiplayer reliability to a releasable build.

## What I built

Versioned release checklists and a data-safety inventory; scripted PNG to WebP asset migration; seeded deterministic combat with an append-only Firestore action log enabling replay; mission, placement and clearance validators.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## What it is for

Shows disciplined delivery: measured optimization, compliance tracking and auditable state.
:::

## Tools

JavaScript, Phaser 3, Vite, Capacitor 8, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, FCM, Android
